Description.DefaultText: Hidden counter: how long until the Wolverine may next come to a big carcass left on the ground.

//Tunables: TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER, never balanced: WOLVERINE_KILL_CLOCK_TICKS 96 (one day at 96 ticks per day), the same 96 as in hw_tgr_wolverine_kill's clock trigger and reset. Its own clock, separate from hw_wolverine_clock, so the trapline roll and the carcass roll never share or reset each other's wait. Climbs at 1 per tick, waits at its max while another gate (the switch, the season or the realm flag) is closed. Only read by hw_tgr_wolverine_kill.
